primary.title: Long Walk to Freedom
primary.author: Nelson Mandela
primary.rationale: Mandela's autobiography, offering a comprehensive personal account of his life, political activism, and imprisonment. It is a foundational primary source for understanding his perspective.

primary.title: No Easy Walk to Freedom
primary.author: Nelson Mandela
primary.rationale: A collection of speeches and writings from Mandela during the period of his political activism and before his long imprisonment. It provides insight into his early political thought and strategies.

primary.title: The Struggle Is My Life
primary.author: Nelson Mandela
primary.rationale: Another collection of speeches, statements, and letters, offering direct access to Mandela's voice and arguments during critical periods of the anti-apartheid struggle.

secondary.title: Mandela: An Illustrated Biography
secondary.author: Philip Brooks
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive biography that utilizes extensive research and interviews to provide a detailed account of Mandela's life and impact, published by a reputable academic press.

secondary.title: Nelson Mandela: The Authorized Biography
secondary.author: Anthony Sampson
secondary.rationale: Written with Mandela's cooperation, this biography offers deep insights into his life and the political landscape he navigated. Sampson was a respected journalist and biographer.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Nelson Mandela
secondary.author: Emma Gilchrist
secondary.rationale: An academic collection of essays by various scholars covering different aspects of Mandela's life, legacy, and political thought, published by a major university press.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are largely autobiographical or collections of speeches/writings. Secondary sources are scholarly biographies and companion volumes from reputable academic publishers.
